title: Koala - Up to 35% off Site Wide + Extra $100 off $1000 spend until Sunday 22/11 @ Koala
body:
Deal: Koala - Up to 35% off Site Wide + Extra $100 off $1000 spend until Sunday 22/11 @ Koala

[mrmaltalian] Very overpriced and overrated for what you get. The designs look a little basic now, not built to last either. Spend a little more and get a better quality product elsewhere tbh
[mrmaltalian] King Living, Koala Living, Lounge Lovers all have substantially better product reviews than Koala for example.
[mrmaltalian] @specwarop: All marketing and I wouldn't be paying almost $2k+ for a mattress compressed in a box. Virtually in the same category as Koala tbh and only do mattresses, not full furniture collection
[specwarop] @mrmaltalian: I was thinking more their Indestruct Bed
[mrmaltalian] @specwarop: That is insanely heavy. Don't plan on moving that anytime soon once it's in place
[SBOB] @specwarop: Have one
Probably overkill but sure is solid, very heavy, but will likeky outlive grandchildren:)
[joedante] I took a peek at those three and they all look worse than the Koala ones. The cheap ones at King Living look like rebranded chinese ones and the expensive ones look like the kind of uncomfortable normal 80s/90s style fold outs. The Koala Living and Lounge Lovers one look like they have a pretty crappy end piece so you can't sleep any direction, has to be the one way.
Where are you seeing these comparative reviews?
[mrmaltalian] @joedante: I own a King Living Sofa Bed and it’s hands down far better than any of the competitors that I researched. It’s used in my guest room and feedback is that the mattress is on the firmer side but is a pretty decent nights sleep
[valkeris] Pretty standard discount for Koala. Seems they have 30% off every second month. The extra $100 off $1,000 is the actual discount, so about 10% off normal prices.
[Toddtian] Looking for single sofa bed, found their rrp is tripled of other brands, not sure if quality and level of comfort match the price…
[dsiritz] Have had their original mattress for over 5yrs now and it has been fantastic - no springs and no bothering partner with separate movements.
I’m definitely going to pull the trigger on their couch.
[MrZ] Is this the same company that makes Koala mattresses?
